children.name:
Provide a continuous software-work system where people create and evolve
    runner-reported agents, work with them as explicit participants, turn project
    conversations into formal work, inspect and redirect coding runs, connect
    decisions to implementation evidence, and follow delivered changes through
    production without losing provenance, access boundaries, rejected
    alternatives, or human accountability.
